name: Tatamiya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood tatami-mat shop (Hiiragi Tatami-ten): a re-covering campaign notice, a first day working part-time at the shop, a usage-and-price guide, a temporary closure notice for machine inspection, a first day measuring a customer's tatami alone, a comparison of two re-covering courses, a short column on why the smell of new tatami feels nostalgic, an essay about teaching a junior staff member how to choose tatami, a long essay on why tatami is being reappraised recently, a short essay on how proposals change depending on the customer, a one-year cooperation report with a local shopping association, a short essay on the sense of security a tatami's texture gives people, and an essay on passing down a craftsman's skill to the next generation. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
